latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Easy Pika AI:

- Instantly generate 1080p AI video clips from a single image or short video by describing what you want.
- Supports quick uploads, automatic cloud rendering (30–90 seconds), and easy MP4 downloads.
- No exports settings or timeline editing needed—just drop media and type your request.
- Secure, automatic API session setup with free trial (100 credits, 7-day expiry) if no token is present.
- Intuitive prompt matching for exports, credits/balance, session state, and uploads.
- Handles errors and expired tokens gracefully, guiding users on next steps if needed.
